title: Interactive latency explorer with streaming/non-stream overlays and error-band annotations
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an interactive latency explorer that lets SREs and platform engineers decompose p50/p95/p99 by model and route, overlay streaming vs non-stream request signals, and surface error-band annotations (HTTP 5xx, inference errors) aligned to the same timeline. The view should support: model-variant filtering, route tag filtering, time-shift comparison (e.g., compare last 60m streaming vs non-streaming), dynamic cohort selection by request shape (sequence length, tokens), and links into traces for sampled spans. Primary goal: make root-cause of tail spikes and error bursts visible without ad-hoc tracing lookups.
acceptance_criteria: Explorer displays p50/p95/p99 timelines for selected model(s) and route(s) over arbitrary time windows
Streaming and non-streaming series are drawn on the same time axis with configurable aggregation window (1s/10s/1m)
Error-band overlays show percent of failed requests and annotate notable trace-linked incidents with timestamp and link to trace
Filters: model, model_variant, route, region, request_shape bucket (short/medium/long) all work and update charts within 2s for 1h windows
Users can open a representative trace from a spike point (trace id sampled) and see correlation metadata: batch size, KV-cache hit, kernel-profile tag
Dashboard integrates with existing SLOs and can color segments where p99 breaches configured SLO thresholds
Dashboard UI and API pass load test for 10 concurrent users querying 24h windows without exceeding frontend timeout
tasks: Finalize telemetry schema: add "io_mode" tag (streaming|sync) to latency metrics and increment trace sampling for p99 spike periods
Instrument runtime to emit model_variant and request_shape (sequence_bucket) tags in metrics and traces
Extend metrics ingestion pipeline to accept high-cardinality tags with controlled downsampling rules
Implement backend aggregation endpoints for explorer (rollups: 1s/10s/1m) and time-shift compare endpoints
Frontend: build interactive timeline, cohort selector, trace link modal, and error-band rendering
Add automated e2e tests and perf regression checks in nightly pipeline
Run canary with internal tenants and collect feedback
